strings.en: Tch...! It can't hold out any longer...!
Oh dear...@How uncool of me, honestly!
Taken down in a place like this...@I'm still so green...!
I leave the rest to you...
To think someone could force me back...!!
Tch!! What an early curtain call!
Th-This is as far as I go...!
Ngh! So this is my limit...!
I'm ejecting, I am...@Ngh...! I can't even go out with dignity...
Damn it!@You won't get me next time!
Kyah! I leave the rest to you!
Me, screwing up in a place like this...?!@This is no fun...
So I, too, still have much to learn...!
A-All hands!@Abandoning ship is top priority...!!
Dammit! Is this all I've got...?!
That was careless of me...@I'll pull back for now...!
Is this... as far as I go...?
Oh, no way! This is as far as I go!!
At my current skill...@this is as far as I go...!
Ngh... Me, made a shooting star...@I'm ejecting!
Ngggh! Not in a place like this!!
N-Not in a place like this...!
Sorry!@I'm gonna have to bow out...!
For the Granzon... to be shot down...
Damn it, is this as far as I go?!
I have no choice but to eject...!
Aw, man, they got me good!
According to a report from Bilgo, who went to@Earth, the Ariard has been loaded aboard the@Steel Dragons' Hagane.
From now on, we focus on that ship and carry out a@recovery operation. However, I don't want to owe the@<Golaikunru> more than I must, so we'll send our own...
I want the Royal Guard focused on defending@the <Rabulpaila>. So, Vort... I'll have you@spare some personnel from your unit.
As you know, the Siebe Drive is our most@closely guarded secret, and one of our@bargaining chips with the Golaikunru, but...
We don't know what condition the Ariard@is in aboard the Hagane. If you judge@it can't be recovered, destroy it.
Yes. That's better than letting the Earthlings@analyze it. We still have two more Siebe Drives.
Understood, but...@why would the Earthlings load the Ariard@aboard the Hagane?
Fairy Klibia may have something to do@with that.
That woman doesn't know what the Siebe Drive@truly is, but she must have understood@that it's our most closely guarded secret...
So she may have told the Earthlings as much,@and left the Ariard with the Steel Dragons@as a way to draw our attention.
...Isn't that a roundabout way of doing things?
Indeed. Fairy Klibia knew of our ties with the@Golaikunru... If she told Earth that, they'd know@we have no intention of making peace.
Even so, the Earthlings sent an envoy@aboard the Hiryu Custom for preliminary talks.
And they didn't seem to realize that@the Golaikunru attack back then was an act.
Yes. When I learned Malum Quisude had secretly@offered peace talks to Earth on his own,@even I was perplexed...
But it seems I worried for nothing.
I thought that, because Fairy Klibia betrayed us,@the Earthlings would attack without ever@coming to the negotiating table.
But Earth's response raises questions.@I can't quite understand why they haven't@sent forces against the Rabulpaila.
Perhaps they have their hands full dealing@with the monsters in Earth's big cities?
That's quite likely... but it's also possible they@haven't gotten the truth out of Fairy Klibia.
I mean that Fairy Klibia may have died@after the Ariard was recovered.
So the Earthlings only got scraps of@information out of that woman?
If you think about it that way, it adds up@to some extent.
Either way, we can't leave the Siebe Drive in@Earthling hands. It must be recovered by@the hands of the Gadisword people.
So who are you planning to send?
Sieg Altolied and Sally Emil.@They once fought in a united front@with the Steel Dragons.
And what's that got to do with anything?
The Steel Dragons know about Leonysis Harga@and the Varga. So I'll have those two pose@as deserters from our side...
...and get as close to the Hagane as possible.
You really think a trick like that'll work?
They'll be more convincing than total strangers.@And to probe our true intentions, they surely won't@shoot down anyone showing intent to surrender.
But won't they just get surrounded,@taken somewhere far from the mothership,@and disarmed?
Even so, they'll be a diversion.@Once Sieg and Sally contact the Steel Dragons,@I'll transfer in reinforcements at the right time.
That's fine, but don't give the two@you've chosen any unnecessary information.
Listen, Vort. Lady Herluga trusted you@enough to tell you the truth.@Make this operation a success and live up to it.
Bilgo dear, your friends are here.
Friends? We're Anex regular army.@Don't lump us in with some upstarts@from the Rattma experimental unit.
You... You don't seem to understand@who you owe your survival to.
I don't remember asking.@If anything, we might've just gotten@dragged into this.
Know your place. The air you breathed@on the Rabulpaila, the water, the food...@all of it was thanks to Lady Herluga.
My, my, you two get along so well.@But I'd like you to go over the operation.@Can you handle the acting?
Maybe not as well as you did,@though.
Is that a dig?@Are you still sore about that attack?@I went easy on you, you know.
Didn't look that way to me.
Oh, well.@Now then, Bilgo dear...@I'll be sending Kinaha out from our side.
I'd like you to send out a few Cupids too.@Thanks to a certain someone, the Golaikunru@and Gadisword connection is out in the open, but...
If your units are mixed in with the pursuers,@it'll be more convincing, won't it?
Well then, Sieg, Sally.@Put on a good show for me.
Oh, and please don't let the act@turn into the real thing, okay?
That's going too far...@There'll be no turning back.
Fairy knew that when she took off@with that Ariard thing.@Isn't that where the truth is?
The Captain didn't tell us the truth.@And what he said before doesn't match@what he said this time.
Herluga and her people have won the Captain over.@The key to exposing whatever they're hiding@is Fairy and the Ariard.
The chances aren't zero.@If the Ariard's aboard the Hagane,@then maybe...
(Could the Captain have thought so too...?)
Maybe we survived thanks to Herluga,@but that's no reason to let her@do whatever she wants.
Plus, the Rabulpaila getting sent here, the Golaikunru,@Chieftain Malum Quisude... There's something behind@every one of them that we haven't been told.
I'm not gonna die as some throwaway pawn@for the Rattma bunch without@knowing the truth.
If they're teaming up with the Golaikunru, then I...
Are you okay with not being able to go back?
I don't plan on it, and it won't necessarily@come to that. I bet Fairy thought so too.
We've only got one chance.@That Iradoya woman seems to have@sharp instincts.
...All right.@I want to know why the Rabulpaila@was transferred to this star system too.
...A briefing with all the unit leaders, huh?@Looks like a big operation's finally starting.
It's definitely about the Lamaris... Are we@going to Paris?
If the Joint Chiefs of Staff thought well of@the experiment my father proposed,@that may be possible.
Have a seat. I've gathered the captains and the@unit leaders to explain our upcoming operations.
The Joint Chiefs of Staff reviewed the results@of the experiment Dr. Kobayashi proposed@the other day, and reached a conclusion.
Our unit's systems, such as the <T-LINK System>,@<Sympathia> and Cytron, have the effect of stopping@the Lamaris from reappearing.
Therefore, the unit will be split in two, and@each half sent to a strategic key point.@The first objective is to retake Paris.
A liberation operation centered on the Southern@Europe Army is planned. The Hagane will take part.
In parallel with retaking Paris, the Hiryu Custom@will continue Lamaris sweep operations elsewhere.
Listen. We are the core of the operations@to destroy the Lamaris. Therefore...
The XO of this ship has something to report.
Commander, two units that appear to belong to EG@are approaching. They've contacted us and@wish to make contact.
They say they don't intend to fight?
Yes, sir. They say they'll agree to disarm.
Hmm... First I must ask for the Joint Chiefs of@Staff's decision. Until the answer comes,@the Hiryu Custom will handle this.
Understood, but to avoid confusion on our side,@shouldn't we release at least part of the@information on EG?
I'd like to ask the higher-ups about that too...@but there's no time for that, is there?@You may explain it at the briefing.
This ship will hold <TD Hovering> at current@position. All units, launch.
Gadisword units decelerating and entering range 3.
Attention, Gadisword units.@Stop where you are, land, and disarm.
Looks like they won't just accept us.
Same type as the one we saw on the Rabulpaila...@Or rather, isn't that the exact same unit?
Do you know the pilots, too?
Guardsword, Ribblerabble... I can't keep@all that straight in my head...
(Gadisword... A new group of aliens, huh?)
I doubt they came straight from the Rabulpaila@to Earth under normal propulsion in those units...
It'd make sense to assume a space transfer.
Attention, Gadisword units.@Open your cockpit hatches...
Radar contact!@Multiple unknowns approaching! Straight in from@one o'clock! Range 4!
...I'll ask Commander Miles for instructions.@Until then, everyone carry out current orders.
Eliminate the enemies in our way in order@to capture the Gadisword units... Correct?
You two, this isn't what we agreed.@Do you really intend to surrender to the@<Steel Dragons>?
Honestly,@to think Lady Iradoya's words would come true...
Bilgo is attacking the Hagane right now.@I came to dispose of the traitors,@and as a diversion.
How can you be so sure we're traitors?!
Then show me by attacking the Steel Dragons now.
What a clumsy exchange.@Now then, I'll dispose of you as rebels.
Never mind that. Shouldn't you be@helping Bilgo?
You may not know any classified matters, but we'd@still rather you didn't leak information. Given@who you'd be leaking it to.
Hmph... If you're coming at us for real,@that suits me fine.@Saves me from telling bad lies.
Among the enemy forces are Gadisword@mobile weapons we saw on the Rabulpaila...
They probably don't need to hide the link@between the <Golaikunru> and Gadisword anymore.
If they intend to openly oppose us,@I'd like to know what they're counting on.
Maybe the Golaikunru have a huge army ready?
If they meant to attack Earth head-on with that,@they'd need a lot of groundwork with the Zovorg@Privy Council. That's unlikely right now.
Then maybe they've gotten hold of a trump card.
(If something like that exists, it's on the Rabulpaila...@That huge cannon? But I don't think that alone@could take on the entire Earth military...)
This is Sally Emil of Gadisword!@They're our enemies! We request protection!
What guarantee is there that@you're not in on it with them?!
There's no time to argue!@They're here to take back the Ariard!
The Gadisword unit inside your ship!@We know it's there!
Captain, they may be a lead for us.
Yes, we should protect them.@Eun, relay to all mobile units.
Roger.@Dragon 2 to all units. Eliminate the pursuers@and protect the two Gadisword humanoids.
I can't afford to be shot down here!
Tch! I'm not doing this halfheartedly!
Damn it, I'm not dying for nothing here!
S-See, fighting the Steel Dragons is risky!@Eject, eject!!
Ngh, I can't take any more risks...!@I have no intention of disposing of rebels@at the cost of my own life!
Captain, all enemy readings in the battle@area are gone.
This ship will hold TD Hovering at current position.@Maintain full-perimeter watch.@Eun, what about the Hagane?
Still engaged, but the enemy seems to be pulling back.
Then it should be over soon.
More or less.@For now, let's drop our weapons@and put our hands up.
Both units appear to be complying with disarmament.@Also, orders just came in from Commander Miles.@Your judgment was correct, Captain.
I see...@Then we'll take the Gadisword units into custody.
(That Org-Valu... There's a person piloting it!)
I am Gayattoba Stecca, aide to the Privy Council's@envoy! Pilot of the Org-Valu, state your name!
(That woman...!@We really do seem to be tied together...@by a rotten bond.)
If we deal with him, we can make sure@the deserters are safe...!
What does it mean that there's a@Gadisword unit on the Hagane?!
We'll just have to ask those two!
(I'd like you to help me dispose of@the traitors too...!)
Those two will be a useful source of information@for us. I'll have to ask you to withdraw.
(Though Sieg Altolied and Sally Emil@don't know anything that matters...)
...Put your hands behind your heads.@We'll handle the disarming.
Yeah, fine.@But I'd rather not be treated like a prisoner.
That's right. Gadisword and Earth are in@peace talks...
I repeat. Put your hands behind your heads.
Leave this to me.@I have the Captain's permission.
I wonder if the girl's about our age.
Fairy! So you were safe after all!
H-How do you know these two's...@these Gadisword people's names?!
Yes. I am Fairy Klibia...@an Anexian of Gadisword.
